dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the stories you spoke of...

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: These are old stories that the desert dwellers are familiar with. Like the adventures of Muzaffar Dey, and the treasure of the evil queen Makhaira. They're very popular with the children.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: Of course, there are also some stories about wisdom... and how to make the right choices.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: Stories always have heroes and villains. But this old man hopes they'll learn — even if they've stumbled onto the wrong path, they needn't keep walking it forever.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: The desert is a harsh and unforgiving place. Those who have survived have invariably learned some lessons, some of which were learned while young, albeit at a price...

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: ...Aha, sorry. I'm afraid I've gotten carried away. You know how it is, us old dogs are always full of tales to tell...
